description: Costs 1 credit for a viewport PNG/JPEG/WebP; +1 for fullPage, +1 for PDF. Returns the image itself. Use this when you need to see layout, styling, or a visual state — for reading text, domscout_extract_markdown is cheaper and more useful.

delay.description: Extra milliseconds to wait after load.

devicePreset.description: Preset viewport and device characteristics. Overrides width/height when set.

format.description: PDF requires a Pro plan or above.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page. Requires Pro or above. Adds 1 credit.

hideSelectors.description: Elements to hide before capturing, e.g. cookie banners.

url.description: The page to load. Must be http(s) and publicly reachable. Credentials in the URL (https://user:pass@host) are rejected; these tools capture as an anonymous visitor, so use the REST API directly if the page needs authentication.

waitForSelector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing.

name: domscout_capture_screenshot
title: Screenshot a page
